verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own menu has an Install section split into categories (Install > Development, Install > Terminal, Install > Windows), and a switcher can find familiar software there, such as VSCode, Cursor and Sublime Text. Nothing documents searching that catalog: the Super + Space launcher opens installed apps, not an installable catalog. Missing for 10: documented search of the install catalog, a documented category filter, a full catalog of familiar consumer apps, and hands-on corroboration of finding apps by category.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can search and filter the app catalog by category to find familiar software

citations.quote: Omarchy supports setting up a whole host of development environments through the _Install > Development_ section of the Omarchy Menu
Pick your preference under _Install > Terminal_ in the Omarchy menu.
Neovim is the default, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim, and Emacs ready to install.
installing software is easy and lightning-fast
